title: Kymaean Alpha Static Conformance Matrix 01

authority.engineer_2_status: ACTIVE under ENG2-QPROD01-DESIGNARCH-02; must rebase/republish/revalidate PR #226
authority.boundary: Existing Design-authorized static work may proceed. New runtime-dependent Design meaning requires integrated exact-main Engineering truth.

classification_key.active_static_law: May be used now for static UI architecture, composition, component design, review and falsification.
classification_key.conditional_design_capacity: Design defines how a meaning should be represented if/when Product truth exposes it; not a build-now requirement.
classification_key.gated_or_open: Design may not invent; wait for integrated Product/Engineering authority or later evidence.
classification_key.prohibited_drift: Non-conforming even if visually attractive or implementation-convenient.

active_static_law: White and Black are the only Alpha user-facing themes and preserve identical architecture/semantics.
Durable visible shell routes are Home, Productions, Settings; Current Production remains contextual.
Studio/Stage/Archive remain semantic spaces, not permanent top-level tabs.
Stage is invariant dark and one shared relational theatrical/social field.
Character carrier is cone presence with floor/name identity+interaction hinge.
Character name is primary explicit identity and does not depend on color/portrait/motion/position/provider/Performer.
Focus and selection remain independent and localize to floor/name semantic target.
Every essential state requires structural/textual redundancy before color/motion reinforcement.
Contextual/deep disclosure is invoked and preserves exact semantic return; Back/Close is not Undo.
Responsive geometry yields secondary context before Character identity/state semantics.
2-5 present Characters remain static design-stress evidence only, not Product cardinality.
gated_or_open: persisted Production-internal content beyond currently earned Product truth
key_reconciliation: Static Design capacity is not currently earned Product state. Implementation may render conditional capacities only when integrated Product truth actually exposes them.

reconciliations: Studio/Stage/Archive are semantic spaces only; Home/Productions/Settings govern durable visible navigation.
Light F2/Dark D3 remain research lineage; Alpha user-facing theme names are White/Black.
A separate state line may be absent when no distinct state needs communication; essential distinct states still require structural/textual redundancy.
Contextual actions may sit adjacent to a selected anchor but remain transient application chrome and may move to overlay/sequential surfaces.
Theme parity requires the same composition for the same state/viewport but does not freeze final pixel geometry.
Performance/opportunity/relationship/history presentation rules are conditional capacities until Product truth exists.

prohibited_drift: mandatory Current Production fourth nav item
embedded creator buttons inside Character cones
unsupported semantic meaning assigned from center/proximity/scale
theme-specific behavior or narrow-only feature removal
invented runtime content used to populate a Design-defined capacity

failure_routing.static_design_conflict: Repair the smallest Design layer against L-264 through L-269.
failure_routing.conditional_capacity_without_product_tru: Do not invent data/behavior; wait for integrated Engineering authority.
failure_routing.density_or_responsive_evidence_exceeded: Open a new bounded Design study.
failure_routing.native_implementation_question: Route to Engineering after an authorized consumer boundary exists.
failure_routing.motion_timing_transcript_question: Remain separately gated; do not smuggle through static implementation.

non_authority: No promotion of conditional capacities into implementation requirements
